# Ezekiel 46 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 46:1 (overlap: 10%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Thus says the-Lord YHWH: "The-gate-of the-inner court which faces east shall-be-shut the-six working days, and-on-the-day-of the-Sabbath it-shall-be-opened, and-on-the-day-of the-new-moon it-shall-be-opened." |
| LOGOS | Thus says the Lord GOD: "The gate of the inner court that faces east shall be shut on the six working days, but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened." |
| PNEUMA | This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "The east gate of the inner courtyard will be closed during the six workdays each week, but it will be opened on Sabbath days and new moon festivals." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
